posts.title: Brasov - historic old town, ski resort, and urban mountain
posts.description: Visit time: 2026-03-11 to 2026-03-15 It does not surprise me that this beautiful historic city is the most popular tourist destination in Romania. Its historic old town is well-preserved and well-maintained. Romania's largest ski resort, Poiana Brașov, is in its suburb. A highly hikable mountain is right by the old town.
